52/S0.subgoal: Introduce the second optimization approach, which focuses on maximizing points of interest (POIs) given time constraints.

52/S1.subgoal: Define the problem of finding an optimal path that covers the maximum number of POIs within a specific Time Threshold (TTH).

52/S2.subgoal: Explain why nodes in the virtual environment need an assigned importance value, and define the importance function.

52/S3.subgoal: Formulate the initial objective of maximizing the total importance (FP) for paths that complete within the time threshold.

52/S4.subgoal: Define the concept and function of waiting time (W) associated with a point of interest.

52/S5.subgoal: Revise the optimization problem to include total waiting time (WP) in addition to total importance (FP).

52/S6.subgoal: Identify the problem as VRPP (Vehicle Routing Problem with Profit) and describe its role in maximizing importance.

52/S7.subgoal: Outline the detailed algorithmic steps required to use the VRPP solver to find the optimal path.

52/S8.subgoal: Summarize the difference between the minimum-time approach and the importance-weighted, time-constrained approach.
